advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) are higher than projected revenue ({revenue}). Before investing, check each major cost, confirm realistic yield assumptions, verify the current selling price with buyers and test the enterprise at a manageable scale.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% leaves a narrow safety margin. A modest fall in selling price, yield or survival can remove the projected profit. Reduce avoidable costs, improve production efficiency and secure buyers before scaling.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% indicates a potentially workable margin if your production assumptions hold. Protect it by confirming input prices, monitoring yield closely, reducing post-harvest losses and checking the market before harvest.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% produces a strong projected return under the current assumptions, but the calculator is a planning tool rather than a guarantee. Confirm costs and selling prices locally, secure a realistic market and keep production records so the result can be tested against actual performance.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price is around {low} for {commodity}. Keep a safety margin: control production costs, improve quality and avoid relying on a single buyer.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices can change sharply by season and location. Plan irrigation and disease management carefully, harvest at the right maturity, reduce handling losses and identify buyers before peak harvest so more of your crop reaches the market in saleable condition.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Use trellising or staking where practical to keep fruits clean, improve airflow and make harvesting easier. Because cucumber is highly perishable, plan regular harvesting and arrange nearby buyers such as retailers, restaurants and hotels before production peaks.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Yield is strongly affected by planting material, weed control and soil fertility during early growth. Use healthy stems, establish the crop quickly, control weeds early and consider processing or reliable bulk buyers so higher yield can translate into better returns.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Profit depends on yield, input costs and the price available at harvest. Use quality seed suited to your environment, manage weeds and nutrients early, monitor pests and plan safe drying and storage so you are not forced to sell immediately when prices are weak.
advice.tipRiceBody: Rice profitability depends on field management, harvest losses, drying, milling quality and market access. Plan water and nutrient management early, harvest at the appropriate moisture level and arrange drying, milling and buyers before the crop is ready.
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Pepper can generate strong returns but prices and quality vary quickly. Use healthy seedlings, maintain steady irrigation and pest management, harvest frequently and handle fruits carefully. Identify buyers and packaging requirements before peak harvest.
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is usually the largest broiler cost, so monitor feed intake, growth and mortality every day. Start with reliable chicks, maintain ventilation and biosecurity, control heat and water access, and schedule buyers before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerBody: Layer profitability depends on feed efficiency, flock health and consistent egg sales. Record daily feed use, egg production and mortality, maintain clean water and housing, and build dependable buyers so production is not disrupted by weak market access.
advice.tipFishBody: Feed efficiency and water quality are central to fish profitability. Avoid overfeeding, monitor dissolved oxygen and water condition, grade fish when appropriate and arrange buyers before harvest. Good records help identify when growth or feed conversion begins to deteriorate.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed, health and biosecurity drive pig production costs. Maintain strict hygiene, monitor growth and feed intake, prevent disease introduction and plan sales around market demand. Use reliable records before replacing commercial feed with alternative ingredients.
advice.tipCattleBody: Cattle fattening margins depend heavily on purchase price, weight gain, feed cost and selling timing. Buy healthy animals, assess body condition carefully, control feed waste, provide adequate water and plan the sale before costs begin to erode the expected margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Goat profitability is strongly influenced by purchase price, health and timing of sale. Select healthy animals, provide adequate nutrition and parasite control, keep records of growth and target periods of strong demand rather than relying only on a high seasonal price.
advice.costControlBody: Review the biggest cost lines first. Your current modeled investment is {cost}. Compare seed, feed, fertilizer, labour, irrigation, transport and post-harvest costs with local quotes, then reduce avoidable costs without sacrificing quality.
advice.marketTitle: Build your market plan before production
advice.marketBody: Do not wait until harvest to look for buyers. Check current prices, identify at least two sales channels, confirm quality requirements and estimate transport and packaging costs before committing capital.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: Use break-even as a decision checkpoint
advice.breakEvenActionBody: Your modeled break-even price is {price}. Compare it with realistic local selling prices and stress-test the plan for a lower price or yield before planting.
advice.recordsTitle: Keep records for the next cycle
advice.recordsBody: Record actual input quantities, labour, dates, yield, selling price, losses and cash received. Compare actual results with this report to improve your next budget.
advice.returnVisitBody: Save this report and return after harvest to compare actual costs, yield, selling price and profit with the estimate. That comparison turns the calculator into a learning tool for future decisions.

advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.

about.title: Des connaissances agricoles pratiques, fondées sur la recherche réelle
about.intro: GoOrganicAfrica repose sur une idée simple : les connaissances agricoles doivent être pratiques, testées et partagées librement en Afrique.
about.whoText: Les guides et outils de GoOrganicAfrica sont créés par {author} — agriculteur, chercheur agricole et producteur de biofertilisants organiques, titulaire d'un certificat en agriculture depuis 2001. Nos guides et données du Calculateur gratuit de rentabilité agricole reposent sur l'expérience réelle de production et une recherche continue, pas seulement sur la théorie.
about.whatText: Au-delà de la recherche et de la rédaction, le travail de GoOrganicAfrica couvre plusieurs produits agricoles biologiques :
about.inoc: InoculumPlus — un biofertilisant organique à base de mycorhizes vendu aux agriculteurs du Nigeria, du Cameroun et du Niger
about.organic: OrganicGrow — une solution biologique pour la volaille, les poissons et autres animaux d'élevage, utilisée par des agriculteurs au Cameroun et en Côte d'Ivoire
about.toolsIntro: Nous proposons deux ressources principales aux agriculteurs africains :
about.calculatorText: — calculez vos coûts de production, revenus attendus, bénéfices, ROI et seuil de rentabilité dans {countries} pays africains et {enterprises} activités agricoles, avec conversion automatique des devises
about.guidesText: — des guides pratiques étape par étape sur le fourrage hydroponique, l'élevage de mouches soldats noires, la culture des pleurotes et la production de manioc sans désherbage
about.missionText: Contribuer à rendre l'agriculture au Nigeria, en Afrique et dans le monde plus rentable et plus durable — un guide et un outil pratiques, testés à la ferme, à la fois. Découvrez nos dernières analyses sur le blog agricole GoOrganicAfrica.

dataUpdates.title: Sources et mises à jour des données agricoles
dataUpdates.intro: GoOrganicAfrica est conçu pour actualiser les données agricoles de référence provenant des gouvernements, marchés et agences agricoles pertinentes, tout en soumettant les changements incertains à examen.
dataUpdates.auto: Que peut-on mettre à jour automatiquement ?
dataUpdates.auto1: Prix de vente des produits agricoles provenant de données fiables du marché ou des gouvernements.
dataUpdates.auto2: Prix des semences, y compris variété, marque, taille du paquet, fournisseur et localisation lorsque la source les fournit.
dataUpdates.auto3: Prix du bétail et des animaux lorsque des données fiables et lisibles par machine sont disponibles.
dataUpdates.auto4: Données sur les engrais, aliments, irrigation, main-d'œuvre et autres coûts d'intrants lorsque des sources fiables sont configurées.
dataUpdates.auto5: Données de taux de change afin que les devises puissent être actualisées indépendamment des hypothèses agronomiques.
dataUpdates.protectText: La collecte automatisée ne remplace pas aveuglément les valeurs du calculateur. Le système enregistre la source, la date, l'unité et la zone géographique et peut soumettre les changements à examen. C'est essentiel lorsqu'un fichier gouvernemental modifie ses colonnes, unités ou définitions régionales.

advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) exceed your projected revenue ({revenue}). Before committing funds, review costs, yield and the market price.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% is low for agriculture. A drop in price or yield could remove your profit; reduce costs and secure better buyers.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% is a solid return if your inputs and selling price hold. Monitor seasonal prices and input-cost inflation.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% is excellent. Confirm the result at a manageable scale, secure buyers and keep detailed cost records.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price for {commodity} is around {low}. Reduce costs or target premium buyers if prices fall.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices are highly seasonal. Consider dry-season production and rapid transport or processing to reduce post-harvest losses.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Stake cucumbers to improve quality and reduce disease. Urban supermarkets, hotels and restaurants can pay a premium.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Value addition can improve cassava returns. Early weed management is essential for protecting yield.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Storage can improve maize returns after harvest. Use safe storage to sell when seasonal stocks are lower.
advice.tipRiceBody: Milling and quality grading can increase rice value. Plan drying and market access before harvest.
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Harvest frequently and handle peppers carefully. Secure buyers before peak harvest to manage price swings.
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is the main cost. Buy reliable chicks, manage feed closely and plan sales before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerBody: Track feed conversion and egg production daily. Stable buyers and good flock health protect margins.
advice.tipFishBody: Control feed waste and water quality. Grade fish regularly and arrange buyers before harvest.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.
advice.tipCattleBody: Buy healthy animals and plan sales around strong demand periods. Feed efficiency drives the margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Time sales for high-demand periods and keep animals healthy. Mature goats can command premium prices.
advice.costControlBody: راجع أكبر بنود التكلفة أولًا. الاستثمار المحسوب حاليًا هو {cost}. قارن أسعار البذور والأعلاف والأسمدة والعمالة والري والنقل وما بعد الحصاد بالأسعار المحلية، ثم خفّض التكاليف التي يمكن تجنبها دون التأثير في الجودة.
advice.marketBody: لا تنتظر حتى الحصاد للبحث عن المشترين. تحقق من الأسعار الحالية، وحدد قناتين للبيع على الأقل، واعرف متطلبات الجودة وقدّر تكاليف النقل والتعبئة قبل استثمار رأس المال.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: استخدم سعر التعادل كنقطة لاتخاذ القرار
advice.breakEvenActionBody: سعر التعادل المحسوب هو {price}. قارنه بسعر البيع المحلي الواقعي واختبر الخطة بسعر أو إنتاجية أقل قبل الزراعة.
advice.recordsBody: سجل كميات المدخلات والعمالة والتواريخ والإنتاج وسعر البيع والخسائر والمبالغ المحصلة. قارن النتائج الفعلية بالتقرير لتحسين الميزانية القادمة.
advice.returnVisitBody: احتفظ بهذا التقرير وعد بعد الحصاد لمقارنة التكاليف والإنتاج والسعر والربح الفعلي بالتقديرات. ستساعدك المقارنة على تحسين قراراتك القادمة.

about.whoText: تم إعداد أدلة وأدوات GoOrganicAfrica بواسطة {author} — مزارع وباحث زراعي ومنتج للأسمدة الحيوية العضوية حاصل على شهادة في الزراعة منذ عام 2001. كل دليل وكل معلومة في حاسبة أرباح المزرعة المجانية لدينا تستند إلى خبرة إنتاج حقيقية وبحث زراعي مستمر، وليس إلى النظرية وحدها.
about.whatText: إلى جانب البحث والكتابة، يشمل عمل GoOrganicAfrica عدة منتجات زراعية عضوية:
about.inoc: InoculumPlus — سماد حيوي عضوي قائم على فطريات الميكوريزا ويباع للمزارعين في نيجيريا والكاميرون والنيجر.
about.organic: OrganicGrow — حل عضوي للدواجن والأسماك وغيرها من الماشية، وصل إلى مزارعين في الكاميرون وساحل العاج.
about.toolsIntro: نوفر موردين أساسيين للمزارعين في أفريقيا:
about.calculatorText: — احسب تكاليف الإنتاج والإيرادات المتوقعة والأرباح والعائد على الاستثمار ونقطة التعادل في {countries} دولة أفريقية و{enterprises} نشاطًا زراعيًا، مع تحويل العملات تلقائيًا.
about.guidesText: — أدلة عملية خطوة بخطوة حول زراعة الأعلاف المائية وتربية ذبابة الجندي الأسود وزراعة فطر المحار وإنتاج الكسافا دون إزالة الأعشاب الضارة.
about.missionText: المساعدة في جعل الزراعة في نيجيريا وأفريقيا والعالم أكثر ربحية واستدامة — من خلال دليل وأداة عملية مجربة في المزرعة في كل مرة. اقرأ أحدث رؤانا في مدونة GoOrganicAfrica الزراعية.
about.externalText: للمزارعين الذين يبحثون عن بيانات وأبحاث زراعية إضافية، نوصي بما يلي:
about.fao: الفاو (منظمة الأغذية والزراعة للأمم المتحدة) — إحصاءات وأبحاث زراعية عالمية
about.iita: المعهد الدولي للزراعة الاستوائية (IITA) — أبحاث المحاصيل والزراعة التي تركز على أفريقيا

privacy.title: Sera ya Faragha
privacy.whoText: GoOrganicAfrica ni jukwaa la elimu ya kilimo na bidhaa za kidijitali linaloendeshwa na Amoo Oluwatoyin Owolabi nchini Nigeria. Tovuti hii hutoa Kikokotoo cha Bure cha Faida ya Shamba, miongozo ya kilimo hai na makala kwa wakulima Afrika.
privacy.collect1: Kikokotoo huhifadhi chaguo la nchi yako ndani ya kivinjari (localStorage) ili tovuti ikumbuke chaguo lako. Data hii huhifadhiwa kwenye kifaa chako tu na haitumwi kwenye seva zetu.
privacy.collect2: Ukituwasiliana kupitia ukurasa wa Mawasiliano, WhatsApp au barua pepe, tunapokea jina na maelezo yako ya mawasiliano kwa ajili ya kujibu ombi lako pekee.
privacy.adsText: Tovuti hii inaweza kuonyesha matangazo ya Google AdSense. Google hutumia cookies kuonyesha matangazo kulingana na ziara za awali. Unaweza kuzima matangazo yaliyobinafsishwa kupitia mipangilio ya matangazo ya Google.
privacy.externalText: Tovuti hii ina viungo vya Selar kwa ununuzi wa vitabu pepe na tovuti nyingine. Hatuwajibiki kwa taratibu za faragha za tovuti za watu wengine. Ununuzi kupitia Selar unasimamiwa na masharti na sera ya faragha ya Selar.
privacy.cookiesText: Tunatumia cookies za utendaji zinazohitajika kwa tovuti kufanya kazi. Hatutumii cookies za ufuatiliaji zaidi ya zinazowekwa kiotomatiki na Google AdSense.
privacy.rightsText: Unaweza kufuta localStorage ya kivinjari chako wakati wowote ili kuondoa data iliyohifadhiwa na tovuti hii. Kuomba kufutwa kwa taarifa ulizotupatia moja kwa moja, wasiliana nasi kupitia {email}.
privacy.disclaimerText: Hesabu zote za Kikokotoo ni makadirio tu na si ushauri wa kifedha, uwekezaji au kilimo. Utendaji halisi wa shamba hutegemea mavuno, bei za pembejeo, hali ya hewa, wadudu, magonjwa, kazi, usafirishaji na soko. Thibitisha bei na gharama za eneo lako kabla ya kuwekeza.

dataUpdates.intro: GoOrganicAfrica imeundwa kusasisha data za rejea za kilimo kutoka serikali, masoko na taasisi husika za kilimo, huku mabadiliko yasiyo na uhakika yakipitiwa.

dataUpdates.auto2: Bei za mbegu, ikiwa ni pamoja na aina, chapa, ukubwa wa pakiti, muuzaji na eneo pale chanzo kinapotoa.
dataUpdates.auto3: Bei za mifugo na wanyama pale data ya kuaminika inayosomeka na mashine inapopatikana.
dataUpdates.auto4: Data za mbolea, chakula, umwagiliaji, kazi na gharama nyingine za pembejeo kutoka vyanzo vya kuaminika.
dataUpdates.auto5: Data za viwango vya ubadilishaji ili sarafu ziweze kusasishwa bila kutegemea makadirio ya kilimo.
dataUpdates.protectText: Ukusanyaji wa kiotomatiki haumaanishi kubadilisha thamani za kikokotoo bila ukaguzi. Mfumo huhifadhi chanzo, tarehe, kipimo na eneo na unaweza kutuma mabadiliko yapitiwe. Hili ni muhimu hasa lahajedwali la serikali linapobadilisha safu, vipimo au maana za maeneo.

advice.thin: Margem baixa — esta atividade apresenta risco

advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) exceed your projected revenue ({revenue}). Before committing funds, review costs, yield and the market price.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% is low for agriculture. A drop in price or yield could remove your profit; reduce costs and secure better buyers.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% is a solid return if your inputs and selling price hold. Monitor seasonal prices and input-cost inflation.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% is excellent. Confirm the result at a manageable scale, secure buyers and keep detailed cost records.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price for {commodity} is around {low}. Reduce costs or target premium buyers if prices fall.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices are highly seasonal. Consider dry-season production and rapid transport or processing to reduce post-harvest losses.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Stake cucumbers to improve quality and reduce disease. Urban supermarkets, hotels and restaurants can pay a premium.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Value addition can improve cassava returns. Early weed management is essential for protecting yield.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Storage can improve maize returns after harvest. Use safe storage to sell when seasonal stocks are lower.
advice.tipRiceBody: Milling and quality grading can increase rice value. Plan drying and market access before harvest.
advice.tipHabaneroTitle: Dica para cultivo de pimenta habanero
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Harvest frequently and handle peppers carefully. Secure buyers before peak harvest to manage price swings.
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is the main cost. Buy reliable chicks, manage feed closely and plan sales before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerBody: Track feed conversion and egg production daily. Stable buyers and good flock health protect margins.
advice.tipFishBody: Control feed waste and water quality. Grade fish regularly and arrange buyers before harvest.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.
advice.tipCattleBody: Buy healthy animals and plan sales around strong demand periods. Feed efficiency drives the margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Time sales for high-demand periods and keep animals healthy. Mature goats can command premium prices.
advice.costControlBody: Analise primeiro os maiores custos. O investimento modelado é {cost}. Compare sementes, ração, fertilizantes, mão de obra, irrigação, transporte e perdas pós-colheita com os preços locais e reduza custos evitáveis sem comprometer a qualidade.
advice.marketTitle: Planeie o mercado antes de produzir
advice.marketBody: Não espere pela colheita para procurar compradores. Verifique os preços atuais, identifique pelo menos dois canais de venda, confirme os requisitos de qualidade e estime transporte e embalagem antes de investir.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: Use o ponto de equilíbrio como referência
advice.breakEvenActionBody: O seu preço de equilíbrio calculado é {price}. Compare-o com preços locais realistas e teste um cenário com menor preço ou rendimento antes de plantar.
advice.recordsTitle: Registe dados para o próximo ciclo
advice.recordsBody: Registe quantidades de insumos, mão de obra, datas, rendimento, preço de venda, perdas e recebimentos. Compare os resultados reais com o relatório para melhorar o próximo orçamento.
advice.returnVisitTitle: Volte após o ciclo de produção
advice.returnVisitBody: Guarde este relatório e volte após a colheita para comparar custos, rendimento, preço e lucro reais com as estimativas. Essa comparação melhora os próximos planos.

privacy.title: Política de Privacidade
privacy.whoText: A GoOrganicAfrica é uma plataforma de educação agrícola e produtos digitais operada por Amoo Oluwatoyin Owolabi, sediada na Nigéria. O site fornece um Calculador Gratuito de Rentabilidade Agrícola, guias de agricultura orgânica e artigos para agricultores em África.
privacy.collect1: O Calculador guarda localmente no seu navegador (localStorage) a preferência de país para lembrar a sua seleção. Estes dados ficam apenas no seu dispositivo e nunca são enviados para os nossos servidores.
privacy.collect2: Se nos contactar através da página de Contacto, WhatsApp ou e-mail, recebemos o seu nome e dados de contacto apenas para responder ao seu pedido.
privacy.adsText: Este site pode apresentar anúncios do Google AdSense. O Google utiliza cookies para apresentar anúncios com base em visitas anteriores. Pode desativar a publicidade personalizada nas Definições de Anúncios do Google.
privacy.externalText: Este site contém links para a Selar (para compra de ebooks) e outros sites externos. Não somos responsáveis pelas práticas de privacidade de sites de terceiros. As compras feitas pela Selar são regidas pelos seus próprios termos e política de privacidade.
privacy.cookiesText: Utilizamos apenas cookies funcionais necessários para o funcionamento correto do site. Não utilizamos cookies de rastreamento além dos eventualmente colocados pelo Google AdSense.
privacy.rightsText: Pode limpar o localStorage do navegador a qualquer momento para remover os dados armazenados localmente por este site. Para solicitar a eliminação de informações que nos forneceu diretamente, contacte-nos em {email}.
privacy.disclaimerText: Todos os cálculos do Calculador são apenas estimativas e não constituem aconselhamento financeiro, de investimento ou agrícola. O desempenho real depende de rendimento, preços dos insumos, clima, pragas, doenças, mão de obra, transporte e mercado. Confirme sempre os preços e custos locais antes de investir.
privacy.contactText: Para questões relacionadas com privacidade, contacte-nos em {email} ou pelo WhatsApp.

dataUpdates.title: Fontes e Atualizações de Dados Agrícolas
dataUpdates.intro: A GoOrganicAfrica foi concebida para atualizar dados agrícolas de referência de fontes governamentais, de mercado e de agências agrícolas relevantes, mantendo alterações incertas sob revisão.
dataUpdates.auto: O que pode ser atualizado automaticamente?
dataUpdates.auto1: Preços de venda de produtos agrícolas de fontes governamentais ou de mercado fiáveis.
dataUpdates.auto2: Preços de sementes, incluindo variedade, marca, tamanho, fornecedor e localização quando disponíveis.
dataUpdates.auto3: Preços de gado e animais quando existirem dados fiáveis legíveis por máquina.
dataUpdates.auto4: Dados de fertilizantes, ração, irrigação, mão de obra e outros custos quando existirem fontes fiáveis configuradas.
dataUpdates.auto5: Dados de câmbio para que as moedas possam ser atualizadas independentemente das premissas agronómicas.
dataUpdates.protectText: A recolha automatizada não significa substituir cegamente os valores do calculador. O sistema regista a fonte, data, unidade e geografia e pode enviar alterações para revisão. Isto é especialmente importante quando uma folha governamental muda colunas, unidades ou definições regionais.

advice.lossBody: Your projected costs ({cost}) exceed your projected revenue ({revenue}). Before committing funds, review costs, yield and the market price.
advice.thinBody: An ROI of {roi}% is low for agriculture. A drop in price or yield could remove your profit; reduce costs and secure better buyers.
advice.reasonableBody: An ROI of {roi}% is a solid return if your inputs and selling price hold. Monitor seasonal prices and input-cost inflation.
advice.strongBody: An ROI of {roi}% is excellent. Confirm the result at a manageable scale, secure buyers and keep detailed cost records.
advice.breakEvenBody: Your break-even selling price is {price}. The reference low-end market price for {commodity} is around {low}. Reduce costs or target premium buyers if prices fall.
advice.tipTomatoBody: Tomato prices are highly seasonal. Consider dry-season production and rapid transport or processing to reduce post-harvest losses.
advice.tipCucumberBody: Stake cucumbers to improve quality and reduce disease. Urban supermarkets, hotels and restaurants can pay a premium.
advice.tipCassavaBody: Value addition can improve cassava returns. Early weed management is essential for protecting yield.
advice.tipMaizeBody: Storage can improve maize returns after harvest. Use safe storage to sell when seasonal stocks are lower.
advice.tipRiceBody: Milling and quality grading can increase rice value. Plan drying and market access before harvest.
advice.tipHabaneroTitle: Ushauri wa kilimo cha pilipili habanero
advice.tipHabaneroBody: Harvest frequently and handle peppers carefully. Secure buyers before peak harvest to manage price swings.
advice.tipBroilerTitle: Ushauri wa ufugaji wa kuku wa nyama
advice.tipBroilerBody: Feed is the main cost. Buy reliable chicks, manage feed closely and plan sales before birds reach market weight.
advice.tipLayerTitle: Ushauri wa ufugaji wa kuku wa mayai
advice.tipLayerBody: Track feed conversion and egg production daily. Stable buyers and good flock health protect margins.
advice.tipFishBody: Control feed waste and water quality. Grade fish regularly and arrange buyers before harvest.
advice.tipPigBody: Feed management and biosecurity are central to pig profitability. Keep strict hygiene and production records.
advice.tipCattleBody: Buy healthy animals and plan sales around strong demand periods. Feed efficiency drives the margin.
advice.tipGoatBody: Time sales for high-demand periods and keep animals healthy. Mature goats can command premium prices.
advice.costControlBody: Kagua gharama kubwa kwanza. Uwekezaji unaokadiriwa sasa ni {cost}. Linganisha mbegu, chakula, mbolea, kazi, umwagiliaji, usafirishaji na hasara baada ya mavuno na bei za eneo lako, kisha punguza gharama zinazoweza kuepukwa bila kupunguza ubora.
advice.marketBody: Usisubiri mavuno ndipo utafute wanunuzi. Angalia bei za sasa, tambua angalau njia mbili za kuuza, thibitisha mahitaji ya ubora na kadiria gharama za usafirishaji na ufungashaji kabla ya kuwekeza.
advice.breakEvenActionTitle: Tumia bei ya usawa kama hatua ya maamuzi
advice.breakEvenActionBody: Bei yako ya usawa iliyokadiriwa ni {price}. Linganisha na bei halisi za eneo lako na jaribu mpango kwa bei au mavuno ya chini kabla ya kupanda.
advice.recordsBody: Rekodi kiasi cha pembejeo, kazi, tarehe, mavuno, bei ya kuuza, hasara na fedha zilizopokelewa. Linganisha matokeo halisi na ripoti ili kuboresha bajeti inayofuata.

dataUpdates.latest: Kipindi cha hivi karibuni cha rejea cha kikokotoo kilichogunduliwa:
dataUpdates.verify: Thibitisha bei kila wakati kwa wanunuzi, wauzaji na hali ya sasa ya soko kabla ya kuwekeza.

resources.financeIntro: Mikopo, bima, ufadhili wa pembejeo, ufadhili wa vifaa, ukodishaji na njia nyingine za kupata fedha za kilimo.
resources.financeText: GoOrganicAfrica inaunda orodha iliyothibitishwa ya fursa za fedha za kilimo. Taarifa zitawekwa pamoja na viungo rasmi na tarehe za uthibitishaji inapowezekana.
